assays.assay_description: Magnet ear-tagged mice placed in a plastic container surrounded by a coil immediately after DOI (0.5 mg/kg) or vehicle; 30-min recording; head twitches detected by signal analysis plus CNN classifier with visual verification; male and female mice; time course in 15-min blocks and total counts.

application_type.evidence: Fig. 2 ... mice injected (i.p.) with DOI (0.5 mg/kg) or vehicle

setup_restrain.evidence: ear-tagged mice were placed inside a plastic container surrounded by a coil

food_restriction.evidence: food and water ad libitum, except during behavioral testing

water_restriction.evidence: food and water ad libitum, except during behavioral testing

time_to_assay.evidence: After treatment with DOI (0.5 mg/kg) or vehicle, ear-tagged mice were placed inside a plastic container ... Testing lasted 30 min.

sample_size.evidence: Head-twitch counts corresponding to the first 30 min after injection of DOI or vehicle ( n = 6 mice per group)

outcomes.summary: DOI (0.5 mg/kg) markedly increased head-twitch counts in both male and female 129S6/SvEv mice relative to vehicle during the first 30 min post-injection, with no sex difference.
outcomes.statistics: Two-way RM ANOVA treatment effect: F[3,20] = 40.00, p < 0.001; total counts vehicle vs DOI F[1,20] = 212.3, p < 0.001; sex F[1,20] = 1.48, p > 0.05; post hoc male p < 0.001, female p < 0.001
outcomes.evidence: Total head-twitch counts were also increased upon DOI administration (vehicle vs DOI, F [1,20] = 212.3, p < 0.001; sex-related differences, F [1,20] = 1.48, p > 0.05).

assays.assay_description: SR-LAB startle chambers; 5-min acclimation at background noise, then 65 pseudo-random trials (pulse-only, three prepulse+pulse, no-pulse) plus 5 pulse-only trials at start and end; ~30 min session. Four stimulus parameter sets (background 65/69 dB, pulse 20/40 ms at 119/120 dB, prepulse 10/20 ms, ISI 60/80 ms). DOI (male and female), DOI + M100,907 pretreatment, LSD (males), and apomorphine/SKF-82,958 controls (males). Measures: startle amplitude to pulse alone and prepulse+pulse, %PPI, within-session startle habituation, startle–PPI correlation.

application_type.evidence: All drugs or vehicle were administered intraperitoneally (i.p.), except apomorphine, which as administered subcutaneously (s.c.).

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room habituation ('Mice were habituated to the testing room at least 1 h prior') and an in-session 5-min acclimation are described; no separate apparatus exposure.

setup_restrain.evidence: recording of the startle magnitude ... was performed using the SR-LAB ™ Startle Response System (startle chamber enclosure; restraint tube not explicitly described)

food_restriction.evidence: food and water ad libitum, except during behavioral testing

water_restriction.evidence: food and water ad libitum, except during behavioral testing

time_to_assay.evidence: In experiments using DOI (0.5 mg/kg) or LSD (0.24 mg/kg), treatment or vehicle was administered to subjects immediately prior to testing. The 5-HT2AR antagonist volinanserin was administered 10 min before DOI or vehicle as a pretreatment.

sample_size.evidence: n = 10 mice per group (Figs. 3, 5, 6, 8, 9); n = 9 -10 mice per group (Figs. 4, 7, 10); n = 7 -8 mice per group (LSD, Fig. 13); n = 4 mice per group (apomorphine/SKF, Fig. 14)

outcomes.summary: DOI (0.5 mg/kg) altered startle amplitude in all four parameter sets and increased %PPI in three of four conditions in male mice; this increase was blocked by M100,907. In females DOI increased %PPI more weakly without affecting startle amplitude, with sex differences in startle and %PPI and opposite startle–PPI correlations by sex. LSD (0.24 mg/kg) increased %PPI in males without affecting startle, whereas apomorphine and SKF-82,958 decreased %PPI.
outcomes.evidence: DOI altered startle amplitude with either pulse alone or prepulse + pulse presentations in all PPI conditions, and increased %PPI in three out of four PPI conditions in male mice -an effect that was prevented by M100,907. In female mice, DOI increased %PPI without affecting startle amplitude. ... In male mice, LSD also increased %PPI

B1_num_measures.evidence: Startle amplitude to pulse alone, startle amplitude to prepulse+pulse trials, %PPI, and startle habituation (pulse-only blocks at beginning vs end of session) are reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Comparing the startle amplitudes in response to these trials before and after the PPI session, our data show startle habituation in both male and female mice (Table 4; Fig. 11).

B4_ethological.evidence: PPI startle magnitude is excluded as ethological per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: PPI is a reflexive sensorimotor gating measure; no learned task.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Univariate ANOVAs and Pearson correlations only.

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on two assays (HTR and PPI); all PPI parameter sets, M100,907 pretreatment, LSD, sexes, and dopamine-agonist control arms collapsed into one PPI assay per rubric.

DOI set to null: candidates disagreed (deepseek 10.1007/s00213-021-05913-5, gemma 10.1007/s11064-...; qwen null) and the markdown contains no DOI. The s00213 prefix (Psychopharmacology) is plausible but unverified from text.
HTR B1 set to 0 ('1'): total counts and 15-min binned time course are the same variable; gemma's score 1 with value '1' was internally inconsistent.

PPI B2 overridden to Yes (following qwen): the paper explicitly analyses within-session startle habituation (pulse-only blocks at start vs end of the same session, Table 4/Fig. 11), which is within-session temporal dynamics, not a between-session pre/post comparison.
PPI B1 set to 4-6 (modal score 2): pulse-alone startle, prepulse+pulse startle, %PPI, and within-session startle habituation.
PPI setup_habituation set to not_reported: candidates citing 'yes' relied on testing-room habituation, which the rubric explicitly excludes; the 5-min acclimation is part of the session itself.

PPI application_type set to i.p. rather than modal 'multiple': the field concerns psychedelic route, and both DOI and LSD (and M100,907) were given i.p. Only the non-psychedelic control apomorphine was s.c.

HTR setup_restrain set to 'no' (modal); the mouse was free in a plastic container. PPI restraint kept as 'yes' (modal), but at medium confidence because the paper does not explicitly describe a restraint tube.

Added dosing entries for M100,907, apomorphine and SKF-82,958, because the rubric asks for every drug compound administered in the behavioural experiments. Ketamine/xylazine anesthesia used for ear-tagging was excluded.
HTR n_total of 24 (12 male, 12 female) is inferred from 'n = 6 mice per group' across a 2 sex × 2 treatment design, consistent with the ANOVA df of 20.
